'''Solipo Yeb''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="ROTSTVD" /> Yeb had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="AskLobot" /> brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and dark skin.<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Yeb was one<ref name="CSWE" /> of the many thousands<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> of mourners to attend the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="CSWE" /> At the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]], he wore a costly maroon and blue [[Andalian cloak]] and a maroon [[shirt]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Solipo Yeb was introduced in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'' by [[James Luceno]],<ref name="ROTSTVD" /> released on [[April 2]], [[2005]],<ref name="ROTSTVD release date">{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|oldversion=20151018025119}}</ref> using reference photos of an uncredited extra.<ref name="AskLobot" /> Due to the reference book's release prior to the release date of the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> on [[May 19]] of that year,<ref name="Year by Year" /> it was unknown at the time whether or not Yeb would appear in the movie.<ref name="AskLobot" /> Indeed, no character matching his description can be seen in the final release of the film.<ref name="ROTS" />

The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]], suggests that Yeb would have appeared during the scene of Padmé Amidala's funeral.<ref name="CSWE" />
